traceability.notes: Story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md is a concrete specification for the `valid-annotation-format` ESLint rule. The implementation in src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts, together with its helper modules, enforces the requested format and syntax constraints for @story and @req (and @supports) annotations. It supports multiline values, flexible parsing of different comment/JSDoc styles, and provides clear, specific error messages influenced by configurable pattern and example settings. Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts explicitly cover each story requirement (REQ-FORMAT-SPECIFICATION, REQ-SYNTAX-VALIDATION, REQ-PATH-FORMAT, REQ-REQ-FORMAT, REQ-MULTILINE-SUPPORT, REQ-FLEXIBLE-PARSING, REQ-ERROR-SPECIFICITY) with both valid and invalid cases, all passing under the project’s Jest suite. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md describes the format rules and gives aligned examples of valid and invalid annotations. The rule is integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict configs and runs alongside the function/branch rules. Based on this concrete evidence, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for Story 005.0 are fully satisfied.
